title: BrandPack
description: Schema for a single brand pack file (e.g. config/brand.json). One file per brand; multi-brand setups use config/brands/<brand_id>.json.

brand_id.description: Canonical slug identifier for this brand (e.g. 'openclaw'). Used as the key when multiple brands are stored.

handles.description: Social media handle for each platform, keyed by canonical platform_id (e.g. 'twitter', 'linkedin'). Use the platform's native handle format.

voice.description: Single-sentence description of the brand's overall voice (e.g. 'knowledgeable and approachable').

tone.description: Ordered list of tone adjectives, most important first.

default_hashtags.description: Hashtags included by default in posts unless overridden. Include the leading '#'.

bio.description: Brand bio in two lengths for platforms with different bio field limits.

short.description: Short bio (≤160 characters) for platforms like Twitter/X.

long.description: Long bio for platforms that support extended descriptions (LinkedIn, Facebook).

logo_path.description: Relative path from repo root to the primary logo file.

brand_colours.description: Brand colour palette. Values should be CSS hex strings (e.g. '#FF5733'). Any keys are allowed; 'primary', 'secondary', and 'accent' are conventional.

forbidden_terms.description: Exact terms (case-insensitive) that must never appear in published posts.

cta_phrases.description: Approved call-to-action phrases available for use in post copy.

_notes.description: Free-text notes, caveats, or TODO items for this brand file.
